ABILITIES.name: Blink
ABILITIES.blurb: A flash of a dodge along your move keys, leaving an afterimage. Two charges that come back on a timer.
ABILITIES.hint: It comes to those who dash: the air dash, again and again. Or: three lobs dodged.

variants.name: Rush Blink
variants.blurb: Further and faster: 8 m a blink, slower to recharge.
variants.hint: Blink until it is a habit. Or: 3.5 s off the ground in one go.

goals.label: 3.5 s off the ground in one go

variants.name: Flicker
variants.blurb: Three short charges, quick to return: 4 m each.
variants.hint: Two blinks so close together they are one. Or: 80 blinks.

goals.label: a blink right after a blink

ABILITIES.name: Slam
ABILITIES.input: C in the air, looking down
ABILITIES.blurb: Drive straight down. The landing throws out a shockwave; Space right after is a big jump, C with a direction turns the fall into a slide.
ABILITIES.hint: Fall from a real height, and land hard. Three times. Or: a fall of 30 m.

variants.name: Quake Slam
variants.blurb: A wider, harder shockwave.
variants.hint: Practice makes the ground tremble. Or: a slam from 25 m up.

variants.name: Super Slam
variants.blurb: The whole floor answers: a huge, ring-shaped shockwave, a bigger slam jump and a longer window to use it.
variants.hint: Something about a great height, and a target that will not hold still. Or: 25 slams onto a target.

goals.label: slam onto a moving target from 50 m up

ABILITIES.name: Roll
ABILITIES.input: Sprint (Shift) while crouched; automatic out of a fall of 20 m or more
ABILITIES.blurb: An evasive roll: press Sprint while crouched and you tumble the way you steer, invulnerable for the first third of it. It also happens by itself out of a fall of 20 m or more, where it mitigates the fall and turns it into speed. Jump out of the second half to keep the speed.
ABILITIES.hint: Fall 20 m or more and land it, three times. The workshop's hole is only 14 m. Or: a slide of 15 m.

variants.name: Tumble
variants.blurb: Rolls out of falls of 12 m, carries more speed, and stays invulnerable a little longer.
variants.hint: Roll until it is second nature. Or: a roll out of a 35 m fall.

goals.label: a roll out of a 35 m fall

ABILITIES.name: Stomp
ABILITIES.blurb: Come down on a pot from above: it shatters under you and throws you back up, air jump restored.
ABILITIES.hint: Break a lot of pots. Some of them will teach you something. Or: five pots broken within a breath of each other.

goals.label: five pots broken within a breath of each other

variants.name: Spring Stomp
variants.blurb: A higher bounce.
variants.hint: A staircase of pots, one after another. Or: 60 stomps.

ABILITIES.name: Paint Dive
ABILITIES.blurb: Melt into liquid clay and move fast through it: up walls, under gaps, launched out with a jump. Lachryma soaks back in while you are under.
ABILITIES.hint: Paint the world with the Paint Shell first. Or: 15 m² of paint in one hold of the spray.

goals.label: 15 m² of paint in one hold of the spray

variants.name: Tide
variants.blurb: Faster through the paint, and a higher launch out of it.
variants.hint: Spend a long while under. Or: one Paint Dive of 20 s.

ABILITIES.name: Wall Latch
ABILITIES.input: C in the air, beside a wall (not looking down)
ABILITIES.blurb: Cling to any wall by your feet and one hand, the other free for the gun. WASD crawls along it, Space kicks off. It does not last: a couple of seconds a jump, then you start to slide.
ABILITIES.hint: Get used to hanging: catch ledges with your hands, again and again. Or: a wallrun of 12 m.

variants.name: Iron Grip
variants.blurb: Hold on longer, and climb faster.
variants.hint: Cling to walls until your fingers ache. Or: a wall latch held 2 s.

ABILITIES.name: Kick & Parry
ABILITIES.blurb: A quick kick that knocks pots over, sends crates and clapperjars flying, and rings targets. Kick a projectile in its first moments and it is a parry: it goes back the way you look, and you cannot be hit for a beat.
ABILITIES.hint: Break a great many pots. Feet first is fine. Or: three moving targets hit.

variants.name: Counter
variants.blurb: A wider parry window: it catches more, throws it back harder, and covers you longer.
variants.hint: Turn something back on whatever threw it. Or: three parries without a miss.

ABILITIES.name: Recoil Jump
ABILITIES.input: fire the gun, aimed down, in mid-air
ABILITIES.blurb: In the air, a shot aimed down kicks you up (and back the way the barrel points). Three shots a jump; a charged shot is worth two. A shot costs what a shot costs: Lachryma.
ABILITIES.hint: Shoot from the air. Often. Or: a target hit while falling 8 m.

goals.label: a target hit while falling 8 m

variants.name: Boost
variants.blurb: Every shot kicks harder, and one more of them a jump.
variants.hint: Kick yourself up, again and again. Or: 3 charged recoil jumps.

ABILITIES.name: Skiff Glide
ABILITIES.input: hold Space in the air on the Solar Skiff
ABILITIES.blurb: On the Solar Skiff, hold Space in the air and the sail catches: a long, slow fall instead of a spin.
ABILITIES.hint: Get the board off the sand. Again and again. Or: 5 perfect pops on the Solar Skiff.

goals.label: perfect pops on the Solar Skiff

ALL_ARTS.hint: The first thing the hand ever learned.

variants.name: Heavy Hand
variants.blurb: Holding is cheaper, and the throw is harder.
variants.hint: Throw a great many things. Or: 5 clapperjars lifted by the hand.

ALL_ARTS.name: Sunder
ALL_ARTS.input: left click and drag across the ground
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Draw a blade across the ground: everything it passes through, in the air above the line, is cut in two along that plane. A cut costs Lachryma, a little more for every extra thing it takes. Works on charted ground.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Cut pots with the psygun's slice shell, again and again. Or: 5 blade mode left with five cuts.

goals.label: blade mode left with five cuts

variants.name: Guillotine
variants.blurb: A longer, taller blade.
variants.hint: Sunder until it is a habit. Or: two things sundered with one stroke.

goals.label: two things sundered with one stroke

ALL_ARTS.name: Swell
ALL_ARTS.input: left click a pot or crate and drag up / down
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Grow or shrink a pot or crate: drag up to swell it, down to shrink it. Its weight follows its size. Costs Lachryma while you reshape it. Works on charted ground.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Lift and throw things with the hand, again and again. Or: a thing thrown by the hand at 12 m/s.

goals.label: a thing thrown by the hand at 12 m/s

variants.name: Colossus
variants.blurb: Swell things to four times their size.
variants.hint: Reshape a dozen things. Or: 12 m³ scooped in one stroke.

ALL_ARTS.name: Wring
ALL_ARTS.input: left click a pot and drag
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Wring the clay: drag sideways to twist a pot about its axis, up to scallop its walls. It stays the same clay. Costs Lachryma while you work it. Works on understood ground only.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Know two places well: map them, and survey them. Or: 6 m³ shaped in one stroke.

variants.name: Wringer
variants.blurb: Twist it round twice, scallop it deep.
variants.hint: Wring a dozen pots. Or: 5 m³ carved in one stroke.

ALL_ARTS.name: Manifest
ALL_ARTS.input: left click, drag and hold
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Raise a wall of clay from the floor: press, drag for its length, hold for its height. It stands for a while, then crumbles; whatever stands where it rises is lifted with it. Costs Lachryma by its size. Works on understood ground only.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Map four places. Or: a raid wave held.

variants.name: Bastion
variants.blurb: Taller, longer, and it stands for a minute and a half.
variants.hint: Raise a great many walls. Or: 5 wave 5 in a raid.

ALL_ARTS.name: Scoop
ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Take matter up and pour it out. Psychokinesis's.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Yours from the start.

ALL_ARTS.name: Shape
ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Raise or lower the ground; Shift to level it. Alteration's.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Yours from the start.

ALL_ARTS.name: Carve
ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Cut a channel. Alteration's.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Reach Alteration 40, or: once.

ALL_ARTS.name: Miracles
ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Draw a feeling's sign to call its weather down. Spellscription's.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Yours from the start.

ALL_ARTS.name: Portal
ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: A linked pair of holes: what goes in one comes out the other. Ouranurgy's.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Reach Ouranurgy 40, or: a grapple swing at 14 m/s.

ALL_ARTS.name: Swap
ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Two patches of ground trade places. Ouranurgy's.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Reach Ouranurgy 50, or: a zandatsu, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

ALL_ARTS.name: Hasten / Stay
ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Matter's time over a patch runs four times as fast, or stops. Ouranurgy's.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Reach Ouranurgy 20, or: blade mode left with 8 cuts.

ALL_ARTS.name: Sculpt
ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Raise a pillar, an arch, a bridge or a ramp of clay. Manifestation's.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Reach Manifestation 20, or: a manifested wall 10 m long, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

ALL_ARTS.name: Lock
ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Set a creation so the mending leaves it be. Manifestation's.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Reach Manifestation 40, or: a sculpted creation of 20 m³.

ALL_ARTS.name: Weather Anchor
ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: Hold a miracle's weather on one spot for a game hour. Manifestation's.

goals.label: a miracle's sign drawn at 90 or better

ALL_ARTS.hint: Reach Manifestation 50, or: a miracle's sign drawn at 90 or better.

ALL_ARTS.name: Layer View

ALL_ARTS.blurb: See the layers under the hand. Divination's.
ALL_ARTS.hint: Reach Divination 20, or: six places mapped, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

ALL_ARTS.name: Flow Preview

ALL_ARTS.blurb: See where a pour will run before it falls. Divination's.

ALL_ARTS.blurb: See a creature's next intent from above. Divination's.

ALL_ARTS.blurb: A stroke of wind. Psychokinesis's.

ALL_ARTS.name: Herd

ALL_ARTS.blurb: Creatures near a drawn line walk it. Possession's.

ALL_ARTS.blurb: Play a creature from above. Possession's.

ALL_ARTS.blurb: Hatched clapperjars carry matter where the hand points. Possession's.

ALL_ARTS.hint: Reach Spellscription 40, or: a Cogitomap brought home, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

ALL_ARTS.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ALL_ARTS.blurb: The epic miracle of the dread sign, drawn with Shift. Ouranurgy's.

kick.hint: Break a great many pots. Feet first is fine. Or: three moving targets hit.

variants.name: Counter
variants.blurb: A wider parry window: it catches more, throws it back harder, and covers you longer.
variants.hint: Turn something back on whatever threw it. Or: three parries without a miss.

recoil.name: Recoil Jump
recoil.input: fire the gun, aimed down, in mid-air
recoil.blurb: In the air, a shot aimed down kicks you up (and back the way the barrel points). Three shots a jump; a charged shot is worth two. A shot costs what a shot costs: Lachryma.
recoil.hint: Shoot from the air. Often. Or: a target hit while falling 8 m.

goals.label: a target hit while falling 8 m

variants.name: Boost
variants.blurb: Every shot kicks harder, and one more of them a jump.
variants.hint: Kick yourself up, again and again. Or: 3 charged recoil jumps.

glide.name: Skiff Glide
glide.input: hold Space in the air on the Solar Skiff
glide.blurb: On the Solar Skiff, hold Space in the air and the sail catches: a long, slow fall instead of a spin.
glide.hint: Get the board off the sand. Again and again. Or: 5 perfect pops on the Solar Skiff.

goals.label: perfect pops on the Solar Skiff

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.input: hold left click on something loose
telekinesis.blurb: Lift anything loose (pots, crates, clapperjars, a mortar ball in flight) and throw it as fast as the hand was moving. Holding costs Lachryma, more for heavier things; let go when it runs dry. Works on sensed ground.
telekinesis.hint: The first thing the hand ever learned.

variants.name: Heavy Hand
variants.blurb: Holding is cheaper, and the throw is harder.
variants.hint: Throw a great many things. Or: 5 clapperjars lifted by the hand.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.input: left click and drag across the ground
sunder.blurb: Draw a blade across the ground: everything it passes through, in the air above the line, is cut in two along that plane. A cut costs Lachryma, a little more for every extra thing it takes. Works on charted ground.
sunder.hint: Cut pots with the psygun's slice shell, again and again. Or: 5 blade mode left with five cuts.

goals.label: blade mode left with five cuts

variants.name: Guillotine
variants.blurb: A longer, taller blade.
variants.hint: Sunder until it is a habit. Or: two things sundered with one stroke.

goals.label: two things sundered with one stroke

swell.name: Swell
swell.input: left click a pot or crate and drag up / down
swell.blurb: Grow or shrink a pot or crate: drag up to swell it, down to shrink it. Its weight follows its size. Costs Lachryma while you reshape it. Works on charted ground.
swell.hint: Lift and throw things with the hand, again and again. Or: a thing thrown by the hand at 12 m/s.

goals.label: a thing thrown by the hand at 12 m/s

variants.name: Colossus
variants.blurb: Swell things to four times their size.
variants.hint: Reshape a dozen things. Or: 12 m³ scooped in one stroke.

wring.name: Wring
wring.input: left click a pot and drag
wring.blurb: Wring the clay: drag sideways to twist a pot about its axis, up to scallop its walls. It stays the same clay. Costs Lachryma while you work it. Works on understood ground only.
wring.hint: Know two places well: map them, and survey them. Or: 6 m³ shaped in one stroke.

variants.name: Wringer
variants.blurb: Twist it round twice, scallop it deep.
variants.hint: Wring a dozen pots. Or: 5 m³ carved in one stroke.

manifest.name: Manifest
manifest.blurb: Raise a wall of clay from the floor: press, drag for its length, hold for its height. It stands for a while, then crumbles; whatever stands where it rises is lifted with it. Costs Lachryma by its size. Works on understood ground only.
manifest.hint: Map four places. Or: a raid wave held.

variants.name: Bastion
variants.blurb: Taller, longer, and it stands for a minute and a half.
variants.hint: Raise a great many walls. Or: 5 wave 5 in a raid.

scoop.name: Scoop
scoop.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
scoop.blurb: Take matter up and pour it out. Psychokinesis's.

shape.name: Shape
shape.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
shape.blurb: Raise or lower the ground; Shift to level it. Alteration's.

carve.name: Carve
carve.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel

miracle.name: Miracles
miracle.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
miracle.blurb: Draw a feeling's sign to call its weather down. Spellscription's.

portal.name: Portal
portal.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
portal.blurb: A linked pair of holes: what goes in one comes out the other. Ouranurgy's.
portal.hint: Reach Ouranurgy 40, or: a grapple swing at 14 m/s.

fold.name: Swap
fold.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
fold.blurb: Two patches of ground trade places. Ouranurgy's.
fold.hint: Reach Ouranurgy 50, or: a zandatsu, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

hasten.name: Hasten / Stay
hasten.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
hasten.blurb: Matter's time over a patch runs four times as fast, or stops. Ouranurgy's.
hasten.hint: Reach Ouranurgy 20, or: blade mode left with 8 cuts.

sculpt.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
sculpt.blurb: Raise a pillar, an arch, a bridge or a ramp of clay. Manifestation's.
sculpt.hint: Reach Manifestation 20, or: a manifested wall 10 m long, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

setfast.name: Lock
setfast.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
setfast.blurb: Set a creation so the mending leaves it be. Manifestation's.
setfast.hint: Reach Manifestation 40, or: a sculpted creation of 20 m³.

totem.name: Weather Anchor
totem.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
totem.blurb: Hold a miracle's weather on one spot for a game hour. Manifestation's.

goals.label: a miracle's sign drawn at 90 or better

totem.hint: Reach Manifestation 50, or: a miracle's sign drawn at 90 or better.

strata.blurb: See the layers under the hand. Divination's.
strata.hint: Reach Divination 20, or: six places mapped, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

course.blurb: See where a pour will run before it falls. Divination's.

goals.label: a crystal's sweet spot ten times running

read.blurb: See a creature's next intent from above. Divination's.
read.hint: Reach Divination 50, or: five windups parried running.

gust.name: Gust

goals.label: a thing thrown by the hand at 25 m/s

gust.hint: Reach Psychokinesis 20, or: a thing thrown by the hand at 25 m/s.

slab.blurb: Lift a slab of ground and set it down elsewhere. Psychokinesis's.
slab.hint: Reach Psychokinesis 40, or: 20 m³ scooped in one stroke, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

herd.name: Herd
herd.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
herd.blurb: Creatures near a drawn line walk it. Possession's.

goals.label: a mind reprogrammed with a held five-word macro

herd.hint: Reach Possession 20, or: a mind reprogrammed with a held five-word macro, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

take.name: Possess
take.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
take.blurb: Play a creature from above. Possession's.

goals.label: the Lockheart opened with three Possibilikeys

take.hint: Reach Possession 40, or: the Lockheart opened with three Possibilikeys.

muster.name: Rally
muster.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
muster.blurb: Hatched clapperjars carry matter where the hand points. Possession's.
muster.hint: Reach Possession 50, or: wave 10 in a raid.

transmute.name: Transmute
transmute.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
transmute.blurb: Sand to clay and back; a pool to your draught's feeling. Alteration's.

goals.label: three things sundered with one stroke

transmute.hint: Reach Alteration 20, or: three things sundered with one stroke, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

ward.name: Barrier
ward.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
ward.blurb: A circle creatures cannot cross. Spellscription's.

goals.label: three sigils cleared in one Celestial mode

ward.hint: Reach Spellscription 20, or: three sigils cleared in one Celestial mode.

stamp.name: Copy Terrain
stamp.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
stamp.blurb: Copy a patch of terrain and press it down elsewhere. Spellscription's.
stamp.hint: Reach Spellscription 40, or: a Cogitomap brought home, or copy its mimicry puzzle cleanly.

stoppedHour.name: Stopped Hour
stoppedHour.input: the hand: its domain (1 to 7), then the wheel
stoppedHour.blurb: The epic miracle of the dread sign, drawn with Shift. Ouranurgy's.

goals.label: its feeling's miracle at full size, its sign at 95, at Dissonance Level 5

stoppedHour.hint: Reach Ouranurgy 80, or: its feeling's miracle at full size, its sign at 95, at Dissonance Level 5.

volcano.blurb: The epic miracle of the fury sign, drawn with Shift. Manifestation's.

goals.label: its feeling's miracle at full size, its sign at 95, at Dissonance Level 5

volcano.hint: Reach Manifestation 80, or: its feeling's miracle at full size, its sign at 95, at Dissonance Level 5.

blink.name: Blink
blink.blurb: A flash of a dodge along your move keys, leaving an afterimage. Two charges that come back on a timer.
blink.hint: It comes to those who dash: the air dash, again and again. Or: three lobs dodged.

variants.name: Rush Blink
variants.blurb: Further and faster: 8 m a blink, slower to recharge.
variants.hint: Blink until it is a habit. Or: 3.5 s off the ground in one go.

goals.label: 3.5 s off the ground in one go

variants.name: Flicker
variants.blurb: Three short charges, quick to return: 4 m each.
variants.hint: Two blinks so close together they are one. Or: 80 blinks.

goals.label: a blink right after a blink

slam.name: Slam
slam.input: C in the air, looking down
slam.blurb: Drive straight down. The landing throws out a shockwave; Space right after is a big jump, C with a direction turns the fall into a slide.
slam.hint: Fall from a real height, and land hard. Three times. Or: a fall of 30 m.

variants.name: Quake Slam
variants.blurb: A wider, harder shockwave.
variants.hint: Practice makes the ground tremble. Or: a slam from 25 m up.

variants.name: Super Slam
variants.blurb: The whole floor answers: a huge, ring-shaped shockwave, a bigger slam jump and a longer window to use it.
variants.hint: Something about a great height, and a target that will not hold still. Or: 25 slams onto a target.

goals.label: slam onto a moving target from 50 m up

roll.name: Roll
roll.input: Sprint (Shift) while crouched; automatic out of a fall of 20 m or more
roll.blurb: An evasive roll: press Sprint while crouched and you tumble the way you steer, invulnerable for the first third of it. It also happens by itself out of a fall of 20 m or more, where it mitigates the fall and turns it into speed. Jump out of the second half to keep the speed.
roll.hint: Fall 20 m or more and land it, three times. The workshop's hole is only 14 m. Or: a slide of 15 m.

variants.name: Tumble
variants.blurb: Rolls out of falls of 12 m, carries more speed, and stays invulnerable a little longer.
variants.hint: Roll until it is second nature. Or: a roll out of a 35 m fall.

goals.label: a roll out of a 35 m fall

stomp.name: Stomp
stomp.blurb: Come down on a pot from above: it shatters under you and throws you back up, air jump restored.
stomp.hint: Break a lot of pots. Some of them will teach you something. Or: five pots broken within a breath of each other.

goals.label: five pots broken within a breath of each other

variants.name: Spring Stomp
variants.blurb: A higher bounce.
variants.hint: A staircase of pots, one after another. Or: 60 stomps.

slip.name: Paint Dive
slip.blurb: Melt into liquid clay and move fast through it: up walls, under gaps, launched out with a jump. Lachryma soaks back in while you are under.
slip.hint: Paint the world with the Paint Shell first. Or: 15 m² of paint in one hold of the spray.

goals.label: 15 m² of paint in one hold of the spray

variants.name: Tide
variants.blurb: Faster through the paint, and a higher launch out of it.
variants.hint: Spend a long while under. Or: one Paint Dive of 20 s.

latch.name: Wall Latch
latch.input: C in the air, beside a wall (not looking down)
latch.blurb: Cling to any wall by your feet and one hand, the other free for the gun. WASD crawls along it, Space kicks off. It does not last: a couple of seconds a jump, then you start to slide.
latch.hint: Get used to hanging: catch ledges with your hands, again and again. Or: a wallrun of 12 m.

variants.name: Iron Grip
variants.blurb: Hold on longer, and climb faster.
variants.hint: Cling to walls until your fingers ache. Or: a wall latch held 2 s.
